links.outcome: Clinician-perceived documentation burden, after-hours documentation, burnout risk, and job satisfaction after ambient AI scribe
links.effect: Majority agreed the tool decreased documentation burden and after-hours documentation, reduced burnout risk, and increased job satisfaction; 48% agreed an additional patient could be seen.
links.quote: The majority of respondents agreed that the AI tool decreased documentation burden, decreased the time spent documenting outside clinical hours, reduced burnout risk, and increased job satisfaction, with 48% agreeing that an additional patient could be seen if needed.

links.outcome: Whether ambient scribe benefit differed across clinician specialty or duration of use
links.effect: Specialty type and number of days using the tool did not significantly affect survey responses; ease of documentation OR 6.91 (95% CI 3.90 to 12.56).
links.quote: Clinician specialty type and number of days using the AI tool did not significantly affect survey responses.

screen.reason: Empirical pre- and post-implementation survey evaluating clinician experience and burnout following real-world deployment of an ambient AI documentation tool (Abridge).
